outcome: Umbilical artery blood gas analysis (base deficit)
cohort: A group of 180 high-risk parturients in the labor ward of Aminu Kano Teaching Hospital.
finding: Admission cardiotocography (CTG) demonstrated 91% sensitivity, 68.8% specificity, and 88.6% predictive accuracy for perinatal asphyxia using base deficit, making it useful in detecting fetuses at risk in high-risk deliveries.
